basis: PR body and changed README, CLI help, command docs and agent skill. No linked issue or separate design specification supplied.

acceptance.A1: An initial hosts-file read failure prevents writes and returns failure.
acceptance.A2: Readable empty content is distinct from an unreadable file.
acceptance.A3: Sync fails when its post-write hosts read fails or the managed block mismatches.
acceptance.A4: Manual zero-route sync reconciles valid managed blocks and reports errors through existing privilege/error paths.
acceptance.A5: getManagedHostnames stays best-effort on read failure.
acceptance.A6: Docs and success text accurately describe the supported cleanup scope.

non_goals: Actual system hosts mutation during review
